about: Record layouts of every game-data table of Crimson Desert 2.04.08 (meta/0.paver 2.4.8.1), read from the 2.04.08 executable's deserialisers through tools/derive_table_layout.py, with per-build reader and field overrides where the tool's model of a reader was wrong. 'fitted' lists the places a layout rests on something other than a read of the executable, such as a width fitted to the data. Each layout is proven by exact tiling: walked from the end of the name-first record header, its fields end exactly on the next record's .pabgh offset, on every record of the table (and of the DLC's copies in 'dlc_tables'). Field names are the executable's own. They say what the game calls a field, not what it does in game, and tiling cannot see two same-width fields swapped, so no value here is checked unless a table lists it in 'verified'. Read-only: nothing that writes game files uses this.

grammar.str n: n bytes, then a u32 length and that many bytes (0: a CString; 9: a LocalizableString)
grammar.list n: u32 count, then count elements of n bytes
grammar.slist n: u32 count, then count times: n bytes and a CString
grammar.plist [specs]: u32 count, then count times the specs in order
grammar.opt n / optloc / optinner spec: u8 presence flag (0 = absent), then n bytes / a LocalizableString / spec
grammar.nullflag spec: u8 flag: nonzero = a null entry with nothing after it, 0 = spec follows
grammar.union pre cases default: u8 tag, then pre, then the tag's case (or default; no default = refuse)
grammar.tagswitch w base cases: w-byte little-endian tag, then base, then the tag's case (no case = refuse)
grammar.tagswitchd w base cases default: tagswitch with a default for a tag that has no case
grammar.cond / condbody: a condition logic / its body, in condition's own grammar

caps.note: the driver's own caps (derive_table_layout._apply); a value above one refuses

regioninfo.verified_by: every nonzero parent is a regioninfo key whose child list holds the region, every listed child is a regioninfo key with that parent or parent 0, and no region is listed by two parents

wantedinfo.verified_by: every record reads one of the 30/50/100/500/1500 price tiers that pabgb_type_overrides.json's WantedInfo note records before 2.04, and each tier occurs
